summary: The cast, the umbrella, the café and the sound bed — three takes each for the two faces and voices. Pick one per asset; everything downstream is drawn from these.

notes.text: Three takes, same outfit. The first holds the damp hair ends best; the toggles read clearly on all three.
The round gold glasses and the long apron hold across takes. The first take stoops a little more, which suits him.
Mustard rather than lemon yellow, so it sits inside the amber palette and still pops against the blue street.
Both masters keep the counter left and the window table right, matching the wide setup. The second has a busier window.
Designed from the roster description alone. Listen for the husk; the second take is the most present.
Sparse felt piano at 66 bpm. It ducks under both lines.
